messages:
dana: Draft announce post, benchmark blurbs, and slides uploaded. Need eng + docs + sales signoff on changelog copy, canonical docs URL, canary windows, and UTMs before I schedule embargo. Quick check here? :clipboard:
rui: Can you paste the exact changelog lines you plan to publish and the proposed canary schedule? I'll validate and add policy id if needed.
dana: Changelog TL;DR for top of page: "Staged canary rollout with automated lightweight fallback to preserve latency during load; detailed rollout and monitoring in docs." Staging doc: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/announce/apr-2026-bench
ben: Suggested short public changelog snippet you can paste:```
- rollout: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 48h
- fallback: auto to 'quant-lite' when error_rate or latency thresholds breach
- policy_id: release-apr-2026-canary
```
anna: Webinar target: Tue 2026-04-07 16:00 PT (23:00 UTC). Panel + live demo. Registration form needs UTMs and SFDC mapping. Proposed UTMs: ?utm_campaign=apr_launch_2026&utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=email. For paid ads add utm_term=paid.
sales-ops: SFDC mapping request: route leads to queue=inbound_ml_platform; add tag product=AprLaunch26. For paid (utm_term=paid) set lead_priority=high and assign to SDR rotation 'sdri_apr'. We can wire the webhook once UTMs final.
rui: Canary schedule (eng signoff): start Tue 04/07 23:00 UTC at 10% to variant `v5-quant-lite`, hold 6h, ramp to 50% Wed 04/08 09:00 UTC, full 04/09 03:00 UTC if metrics green. Rollback target: `v4-stable`. Monitoring thresholds: token-error >1.5% or p95 latency increase >20% triggers auto-pause.
dana: Plan to lift embargo Thu 04/09 09:00 PT if we get go/no-go by EOD tomorrow. Marketing needs final links for the announce, docs, and webinar registration to schedule posts and paid slots.
ben: I'll add a short product note calling out Dedicated behavior: "Dedicated customers retain pinned capacity by default; Hosted customers use automatic fallbacks unless opted out." Keep it one sentence.
ops-bot: Canary job queued: name=apr-2026-canary, variant=v5-quant-lite, initial_traffic=10%, monitor_url=/ops/releases/apr-2026
sales-ops: :thumbsup: Will map SFDC when final UTMs are posted.
rui: :thumbsup: Eng good with schedule and wording. I'll attach policy id to product notes and notify SRE.
anna: :thumbsup: I'll publish the registration page once UTMs confirmed and paste the canonical link here.
dana: Please react with :thumbsup: when your lane is green. Need final go/no-go by EOD for embargo lift. Thanks all :rocket:
